messages:
maya_chen: quick heads-up — I pushed a design pass for the org settings page (roles grid, invite modal, SSO toggles, audit log nav). Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Org-Settings-UX — prototype attached. Can folks skim and drop UX/accessibility nits? :eyes:

 dave_park: looked — nice layout. main nit: the roles grid feels very wide on 1280px. can we collapse 'inherited permissions' into a chevron that expands? saves vertical space too. also the role chips overflow on long names.

maya_chen: yeah collapsing inherited perms was my thought too. dave, can you mock the collapsed state? would like the quick summary to show e.g. "Read · Write · Manage»" and then expand to full list.

sanjay_rao: a11y notes from my pass: keyboard focus order goes Role Name -> Create button -> Permissions column. should be Role Name -> Permissions -> Actions. right now screen reader users hit the action menu before seeing permissions. also contrast on the disabled toggle is 2.8:1 — needs to be >=3:1 for AA for small UI elements.

eli_thompson: small copy tweak for invite modal: current copy: "Invite teammates by email" -> suggest: "Invite teammates by email or link" when link-sharing is enabled. makes the affordance clearer.

maya_chen: good call. here's suggested modal copy block — can we update before next prod review?
```
Invite teammates
Add an email address or copy an invite link to share. People you invite will be added to your org with the role you select.
```

dave_park: copy LGTM. also propose moving the SSO toggle out of the top-level 'Authentication' card and into a collapsible 'SSO and SAML' section under Security — reduces visual noise for small teams who don't use SSO.

eli_thompson: +1 on moving SSO. also we need a clear states matrix: On (enforced) / On (optional) / Off. right now the mock only shows a single toggle which is ambiguous about enforcement.

maya_chen: noted — will add enforcement states. sanjay, can you verify the new states for aria-labels? e.g., aria-label="SSO enforcement: on-optional" ?

sanjay_rao: yes, and expose a descriptive tooltip for screen readers: use aria-describedby on the toggle with a visually-hidden element describing behavior when enforced vs optional. also test with NVDA.

eli_thompson: audit log nav feedback: the current design tries to show filters inline which pushes the table down. Can we adopt a left-side collapsible filter rail (sticky) + main table? that keeps column headers visible. and add a persistent quick-search that does fuzzy match across actor/resource/action.

dave_park: makes sense. also request a "jump to audit" keyboard shortcut (g then a) per product pattern? would help power users.

maya_chen: love the shortcut suggestion — will add to the keyboard shortcut spec. also plan to add event names for analytics: audit.search, invite.send_modal_open, invite.send_success, roles.grid_expand. assignable?

eli_thompson: I'll add analytics names to the spreadsheet. quick thing: can we make role color palette meet color-blind safe constraints? current red/green combination fails. use blue/orange/teal variants.

maya_chen: noted. i'll adjust palette in figma.

design-bot: design-lint report: 6 contrast warnings, 2 focus-order issues (roles grid), 1 missing aria-describedby (SSO toggle). See /design-lint/1752009876.

dave_park: thanks bot. i'll send a quick PR for the grid DOM order to fix focus.

sanjay_rao: i can run a SR test if you want — put up a build on staging and ping me.

maya_chen: plan: i'll update figma with collapsed inherited perms, enforcement states for SSO, invite copy, palette, and audit rail mock by EOD tomorrow. then we'll hand off to eng for a small DOM reorder patch and qa on a11y. anybody object to that timeline?

eli_thompson: fine by me.

dave_park: good. :thumbsup:

sanjay_rao: ok — will schedule SR pass after staging is up.

maya_chen: thanks all — i'll post updated figma when done. :sparkles:
